title: The bird on the bench
logline: The seawall bench at the end of the last tourist season the book takes: the bird on the bench's back, the crow on the wall, the pup under, and a man in plaid at the bench's end from behind. Everything in its place.

panels.composition: A seawall bench from behind in late August with the small rainbow bird on its back rail, a crow on the wall, an old three-legged dog beneath it, and a man in plaid at its end from behind, the bay.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a seawall bench seen from behind in late August with a small rainbow bird on its back rail, a crow on the wall beyond, an old three-legged dog beneath the bench and a man in plaid flannel seated at its end from behind, a bay beyond, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
